center_definition.required_method: fit the complete narrow and wide textured rubber-pad surfaces independently at each jaw command; derive the cylinder center from the fitted surfaces at that command
center_definition.forbidden_substitute: Do not use a fingertip, a fixed local point, or a single command-independent midpoint as the cylinder center.

scope: This fixes only the visual/grasp-frame orientation convention.
It does not change the frozen STL model, joint table, collision geometry, forces, contact settings, or physical-grasp qualification.
